listing.name: Plants vs. Zombies (Xbox Live Arcade) — pvz-console-edition (ITSeniy)
listing.summary: The project describes the 0.7.0 beta as playable from start to finish, with remaining rough edges. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Provide your own Plants vs. Zombies (Xbox Live Arcade) Xbox 360 XBLA package or its complete extracted files. Title 584109FF/version 0.0.1.4.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Download Windows archive and import own XBLA package or disc on first run; only version 0.0.1.4 is supported.

warnings: The project describes the 0.7.0 beta as playable from start to finish, with remaining rough edges.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
